            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
            str = null;
        }
        Scan(InputStream x)

            br=new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(x));
            str=null;
        }
        String next()
        {
            while(str==null||!str.hasMoreTokens()){
                try{

                }catch (Exception e){
                    out.println(e);
                }
            }
            return str.nextToken();
        }
        int nextInt()

            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }
        double nextDouble()

            return Double.parseDouble(next());
        }
        String nextLine()
        {
            try {
                if (str == null || !str.hasMoreTokens())str=new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            }catch (IOException e){
                out.println(e);
            }
            return str.nextToken("\n");
        }
    }
    static long MOD=998244353L;
    static int asz=200005;
    static long BigMod(long a,long b,long m){
        if(b==0)return 1L;
        if(b%2==1)return a*BigMod(a,b-1,m)%m;
        return BigMod(a*a%m,b/2,m)%m;
    }
    static long f[]=new long[asz];
    static long C(int n,int k){
        if(k>n)return 0L;
        return f[n]*BigMod(f[k],MOD-2,MOD)%MOD*BigMod(f[n-k],MOD-2,MOD)%MOD;

            else ans=(ans-C(n-k,i)*BigMod(n-k-i,n,MOD)%MOD+MOD)%MOD;
        }
        return ans;
    }
